articles.title: Candidate named Hitler Mussolini elected mayor in Peru
articles.highlight: 据当地选举数据，名叫希特勒·墨索里尼·西梅翁·弗洛雷斯的商人当选秘鲁安第斯偏远地区市长。
articles.summary: 这则国际新闻称，左翼候选人希特勒·墨索里尼·西梅翁·弗洛雷斯在秘鲁安第斯偏远地区击败极右翼对手，当选为Queropalca的市长。他45岁，与两位臭名昭著的欧洲独裁者同名，将于1月1日就职。值得一看的是，奇特姓名如何让一则地方选举新闻受到国际关注。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键看点：候选人名字与两位欧洲独裁者相同，使这则偏远地区地方选举新闻获得国际关注。现有信息只涉及选举结果和就职日期，并未展开其政策主张。
articles.sourceExcerpt: Leftwing Hitler Mussolini Simeon Flores beats far-right candidate in election in remote district of Andes A businessman called Hitler Mussolini Simeon Flores has been elected the mayor of a remote district in the Peruvian Andes, according to local election data. The 45-year-old, who shares two of his names with the notorious European dictators, won the race for mayor of Queropalca, in Peru’s central Huánuco region, and will take office on 1 January.

articles.title: ‘Like a drill going into my eye’: why the mystery over Havana syndrome refuses to die
articles.highlight: 2019年4月的一个凌晨1点刚过，一名出差伦敦的中情局官员在酒店房间里被前所未有的剧烈头痛惊醒。
articles.summary: 过去十年间，数十名中情局官员出现脑雾、失去平衡、严重耳鸣等衰弱症状。围绕这些症状究竟是“群体癔症”，还是某种能量武器攻击、若有攻击又是谁所为、以及是否存在掩盖，至今没有定论。文章通过一名驻伦敦官员的亲身经历，梳理这场争议为何持续发酵，适合想了解情报机构健康事件争议全貌的读者。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键启示是：当症状真实存在却缺乏可公开核验的物证时，官方结论、当事人体验与政治猜测会长期并行，判断这类事件时应区分“无法解释”与“已被证伪”。
articles.sourceExcerpt: Dozens of CIA officers have been afflicted by debilitating symptoms over the past decade. Are they the result of ‘mass hysteria’? Or are they from attacks with an energy weapon and, if so, who is responsible?

en.highlight: Shortly after 1am one night in April 2019, a CIA officer on a work trip to London was jolted awake in his hotel room by the most intense head pain he had ever experienced.
en.summary: Over the past decade, dozens of CIA officers have suffered debilitating symptoms such as brain fog, loss of balance and severe tinnitus. It remains unresolved whether these are cases of 'mass hysteria', attacks with an energy weapon, who might be responsible, and whether there has been a cover-up. The article uses one officer's experience in London to explain why the controversy keeps resurfacing.
en.failureAnalysis: The key takeaway: when symptoms are real but no publicly verifiable physical evidence exists, official findings, personal accounts and political speculation can coexist indefinitely, so it matters to distinguish 'unexplained' from 'disproven'.
en.title: 'Like a drill going into my eye': why the Havana syndrome mystery refuses to die

articles.title: How Memory Makes Us and Breaks Truth: The Rashomon Effect and the Science of How Memories Form and Falter in the Brain
articles.highlight: 我们就是我们的记忆……那座由变幻形状构成的虚幻博物馆，那堆破碎的镜子。
articles.summary: 这篇文章来自 The Marginalian，围绕“罗生门效应”以及记忆在大脑中如何形成、如何变得不可靠展开。它借助“我们是我们的记忆”这一意象，提示记忆并非稳定录像，而更像不断变形、拼合甚至破碎的博物馆，从而影响我们对真相的把握。了解这一点，有助于更审慎地看待自己与他人的叙述。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键启示：记忆的可塑性既构成自我，也让真相容易随视角而分裂；理解记忆如何形成与失准，能帮助人更审慎地对待叙述和判断。
articles.sourceExcerpt: "We are our memory… that chimerical museum of shifting shapes, that pile of broken mirrors.”

zh.title: 记忆如何成就我们，又如何瓦解真相：《罗生门效应》与大脑记忆形成和失准的科学

en.highlight: We are our memory… that chimerical museum of shifting shapes, that pile of broken mirrors.
en.summary: This article from The Marginalian explores the Rashomon effect and the science of how memories form and falter in the brain. Using the image that we are our memory, it suggests memory is not a stable recording but a shifting, reassembling, even broken museum that shapes our grasp of truth. It is worth reading for a more cautious view of our own and others' accounts.
en.failureAnalysis: Key takeaway: memory's plasticity both constitutes the self and makes truth prone to splitting by perspective; understanding how memory forms and falters can help us treat narratives and judgments more carefully.

articles.title: App+1｜专注星空：让「少刷手机」这件事更愉悦一点
articles.highlight: 把决定使用时长的时机放到每次打开应用之前，让「少刷手机」这件事更愉悦一点。
articles.summary: 少数派「App+1」栏目介绍了一款名为「专注星空」的应用，它的核心思路是把决定使用时长的时机提前到每次打开应用之前。也就是说，不是等到刷完再后悔，而是在动手之前先想清楚要用多久。对于想减少手机使用又不想被强硬限制的人来说，这种更温和、更有掌控感的方式值得一看。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键点在于用「事前设定」替代「事后自责」：在打开应用前先决定用多久，比事后靠意志力刹车更符合人的行为习惯。

en.highlight: Move the moment of deciding how long you will use an app to before each time you open it, making 'scrolling less' a bit more pleasant.
en.summary: Minority Post's 'App+1' column introduces an app called Focus Starry Sky, whose core idea is to decide your usage duration before you open an app, not after. For people who want to cut down on phone use without harsh blocking, this gentler, more self-controlled approach is worth a look.
en.failureAnalysis: The key takeaway is replacing 'guilt afterwards' with 'setting limits beforehand': deciding how long you will use an app before opening it fits human habits better than relying on willpower to stop later.

articles.title: Building AI for Reliable Execution: Lessons From Industrial Robotics

articles.summary: 这篇文章介绍 Standard Bots 的 AI 技术栈：预训练模型先从人类演示中学习工厂任务，再依靠真实生产环境里的纠正反馈来迭代提升。它值得关注，因为它展示了让 AI 在工业场景中稳定可靠执行的一条现实路径——不是追求一次到位的通用智能，而是把学习闭环嵌入真实部署。

en.highlight: Inside Standard Bots' AI stack, pretrained models learn factory tasks from demonstrations and improve through corrections from real deployments.
en.summary: This article looks at Standard Bots' AI stack, where pretrained models learn factory tasks from human demonstrations and then improve using correction feedback gathered from real deployments. It is worth reading because it shows a practical path to making AI execute reliably in industrial settings: embedding a learning loop into real-world deployment rather than aiming for one-shot general intelligence.
en.failureAnalysis: The key takeaway is that reliable execution tends to come from a continuous loop of demonstration learning plus on-site correction, not from a one-time trained model; when deploying in the field, the correction-feedback mechanism itself deserves priority over model scale.
en.title: Building AI for Reliable Execution: Lessons From Industrial Robotics

articles.summary: 这是 Hacker News 上的一个 Show HN 项目，标题显示它让 AI 代理能在屏幕上绘制大箭头、方框和文字，把抽象操作变成可见标注。该条目已获 406 分和 186 条评论，说明 AI 代理如何向人类传达空间信息这一方向引发了较多讨论。对于非技术管理者，值得关注它是否能成为代理与用户协作的通用交互层。
articles.failureAnalysis: 屏幕标注可能只是新鲜演示，真实高频需求尚未被验证，用户可能看完就忘。跨平台悬浮窗、屏幕权限、隐私与安全限制会推高工程成本，而独立开源项目缺乏清晰收费路径。若 OpenAI、微软等平台把类似能力内建到自家 AI 代理中，第三方小工具的生存空间会被迅速压缩。

en.highlight: Let your AI agents paint big arrows, boxes and text on your screen.
en.summary: This Hacker News Show HN item presents a project that lets AI agents draw large arrows, boxes, and text directly on the screen. With 406 points and 186 comments, it has drawn attention as a way to make agent actions spatially visible. It is worth watching as a test of whether visual annotation becomes a real interaction layer for AI agents.
en.failureAnalysis: The idea may fail if screen annotation stays a novelty rather than a frequent need, and cross-platform overlay permissions, privacy limits, and lack of monetization add engineering and business risk. Platform owners could also absorb this feature into their own agent products.
